work_bloodtransport.config.description: Carry blood products, lab samples and urgent medicine between blood supply centers and hospitals.
work_bloodtransport.config.name: Blood Transport

work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.box_contai:
Below is the content of the open container. Items move with drag and drop or a double click; Shift moves one piece, and dragging an item out of the window puts it down.

Close the inventory with {inventory} or ESC.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.box_get_ou: The cargo travels in the blood box of the vehicle. Get out of the vehicle.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.box_hud:
The box is in your hand. The list on the right shows what is in your hands and on your back, with the details of the box.

{drop} puts down what you hold, {inventory} opens your inventory. You can never get into a vehicle with something in your hands.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.box_slots: At the top are your slots: left hand, right hand and back (only backpacks go on the back). The blood box is a container: it shows how many kg of its capacity are used.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.box_take: Go to the rear of the vehicle: the menu of the transport box appears there. Choose Take the blood box.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.deliver_do: Delivered! Close the window and put the box back into the vehicle.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.deliver_dr: Your cargo is marked PUT IN ». Drag it from the box onto the port on the right.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.deliver_po: The blue H marker is the storage port of the hospital. Stand in it and press {port}.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.deliver_ta: You have arrived. Get out and take the blood box from the rear of the vehicle.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.done_text:
In short:
1. Duty marker, then the vehicle marker, then {panel}: Sign on.
2. Tasks come by themselves: Route to the pickup place.
3. Box from the rear of the vehicle, {port} in the port, cargo into the box.
4. Box back, drive, cargo onto the port at the destination.
5. End service when you are done.

/{command} starts this tutorial again.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.drive_go: Drive to {to}, following the route on the radar. Take your time: the vehicle cannot be damaged in the tutorial.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.drive_put_: Put the box back: at the rear of the vehicle choose Put the blood box back.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.note_get_i: Get into the blood transport vehicle.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.note_open_: Press {panel} to open the big view again.
Open the storage window: stand in the marker and press {port}.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.note_put_b: Put the box back into the vehicle (rear of the vehicle).
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.note_take_: Take the blood box out of the vehicle first.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.offer:
Is this your first blood transport service? The tutorial shows the transport panel, a task, the blood box and the inventory, a pickup and a delivery (about 5 minutes, with a short drive).

You can start it later with /{command}.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.panel_open: Press {panel} to open the big view of the panel.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.panel_sign:
This is the big view. A service starts with Sign on, in your own blood transport vehicle; your unit id is its plate.

Press Sign on.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.panel_smal:
You are sitting in a blood transport vehicle in front of {from}.

Bottom right is the transport panel. Its small view shows whether you are in service and the cargo you are carrying.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.pickup_don:
Picked up! The task is now in transit and the route points to the destination. Only your own cargo can be moved, and only the whole amount.

Close the window.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.pickup_dra: Your cargo is marked « TAKE. Drag it into the box on the left, or double click it.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.pickup_por: The red B marker is the storage port of {from}, a few metres away. Stand in it with the box in your hand and press {port}.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.pickup_win: This is the storage window of the port: you and your box on the left, the port on the right. The yellow bar tells you what to do here.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.signoff_op: The task is done. Open the big view with {panel}.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.signoff_pa: Delivered shows 1 now, and the pay grows with it. At the end of a service you get {base} if you delivered at least one task, {delivered} for every delivery, and {in_transit} for every cargo still on its way.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.signoff_pr:
A service also ends when your work duty ends, the vehicle is lost or you die; the open tasks are cancelled then.

Press End service. In the tutorial you get no money, only the receipt.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.signoff_ty:
Other tasks: lab samples go from a hospital to a blood bank, urgent medicine between two hospitals, and the blood banks resupply the hospitals.

Wind down: you get no new tasks, but you finish the ones you have.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.task_heade:
You are in service. The header shows your unit, the state and the service time; Wind down and End service are on the right.

The tiles count the delivered tasks, the cargo in transit, the waiting tasks and the pay so far.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.task_more:
With more tasks, the arrows on the left set their order, and Hand over gives a waiting task to another transporter standing within 6 m (they have 20 seconds to accept).

Close the big view with {panel}.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.task_route: Press Route: the pickup place becomes your target on the radar and the map. After the pickup the route points to the destination. Pressing it again switches it off.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.task_row:
A new task arrived (it also came as a notification). A task shows what to carry (blood product, blood group, units), its tag (URGENT, planned, lab sample...), where from and where to, and its number.

Waiting means the cargo is still at the pickup place.
work_bloodtransport.tut.steps.task_waiti: The tasks are given out automatically. Wait a moment, one is coming.
